_why: Memphis NEIGHBORHOODS and local ANCHORS, the two coverage shapes the city x service generator cannot express. The owner's Search Readiness Checklist (item j9, 25 Oct 2026) holds a hyperlocal site to its own coverage manifest - every town, neighborhood and anchor on the list has its page - and on 2026-10-26 it reported 32 of 64 missing: 20 service x town (fixed by adding the five towns to areas.json) and these 12. A neighborhood is a part of Memphis, not a city, so it has no county, no state line and no travel question of its own; an anchor is a hotel, where the service is a room setup for a guest. Slugs and URL shapes here are exactly the ones the manifest expects (/areas/{slug}-party-decor and /areas/{slug}-hotel-room-decor), so the audit's expansion and this file cannot disagree.
_rules: Only what is on record: the neighborhood's own position in Memphis, and for an anchor the hotel's name and that it is in Memphis. NO claim of partnership, affiliation, approval or preferred-vendor status with any hotel - none exists - and every anchor page says so in its own words and answers the permission question honestly. No prices typed here: they come from data/offers/services.json. No reviews, counts, ratings or "insured" claims.
